newsitem.title: USA: Eastman Chemical adds reporting segment.
newsitem.headline: Eastman Chemical adds reporting segment.

text.p: Eastman Chemical Co said Monday it will include a third segment in its financial reporting, effective with the fourth quarter and year-end 1996 financial information to be released January 21.

The company said the new segment will be named Core Plastics and will include the company's two major plastics businesses, container plastics and flexible plastics. In the past, container plastics were in the Performance segment, and flexible plastics were in the Industrial segment. The segment will include Eastman's two major plastics products, Eastapak PET polyester packaging plastic and Tenite polyethylene.
Concurrent with this change, it said, the Performance segment is being renamed Specialty and Performance, and the Industrial segment is being renamed Chemical Intermediates.

"The company believes this new segmentation provides more useful information for decision making and for understanding the company's financial results," said Virgil Stephens, chief financial officer. "The products within each segment have similar characteristics, the markets share similar economic characteristics, and customers have similar buying criteria."
Information previously reported in two segments will be realigned to conform to the new three-segment approach.
